```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#Loading packages and setting working directory
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(agricolae)
library(lubridate)

california_events_processed <- read_csv(here("Data/Processed/california_events_processed.csv"))

# Changing lc_name variable from character to factor
california_events_processed$lc_name <- as.factor(california_events_processed$lc_name)

# Changing eco_name variable from character to factor
california_events_processed$eco_name <- as.factor(california_events_processed$eco_name)

# changing month to factor format
california_events_processed$ig_month <- as.factor(california_events_processed$ig_month)

#changing year to factor format
california_events_processed$ig_year <- as.factor(california_events_processed$ig_year)
```

## What is the relationship between time of year and which land cover type sees the longest fast fires?

### Response variable: event length? Predictors: land cover, month, year

```{r}
# Group data
event_length_group <- california_events_processed %>%
  group_by(lc_name, ig_month, ig_year) %>%
  summarise(mean_event_dur = mean(event_dur),
            max_event_dur = max(event_dur),
            min_event_dur = min(event_dur)) %>%
  ungroup()

# create new data frame of just question variables
event_length <- california_events_processed %>%
  select(lc_name, ig_month, ig_year, event_dur)

```

Two-way ANOVA
```{r}
# Format as aov
eventlength_aov2 <- aov(data = event_length, event_dur ~ ig_month + lc_name)
summary(eventlength_aov2)

# Format as lm
Litter.anova.2way2 <- lm(data = Litter, dryMass ~ functionalGroup + nlcdClass)
summary(Litter.anova.2way2)

# Run a post-hoc test for pairwise differences
TukeyHSD(Litter.anova.2way)
```
